---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(rhandsontable)
```

```{r}
data2 <- gapmiber1
rhandsontable(data2)
```

let's preview the covid_19 data

```{r}
head(covid_19_data,10)
```

Let's make the last update editable into months

```{r}
rhandsontable(covid_19_data) %>% 
  hot_col("Last Update",type="date" ,dateFormat = "YY-MM-DD")

```

Now let's put a data validation to the columns deaths to only pick numerics

```{r}
rhandsontable(covid_19_data) %>% 
  hot_validate_numeric(col="Deaths", min = 0 ,max = 1000)
```

To make a certain rows read only

```{r}
rhandsontable(covid_19_data) %>% 
  hot_cols(cols =c("Province/State","Country/Region"),readOnly = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rhandsontable(covid_19_data) %>% 
  hot_row(row = 2 ,readOnly = TRUE)
```

COMMENTS

To add comments into a column such that as the user hovers around the column it displays a tooltip

```{r}
rhandsontable(regression_data) %>% 
  hot_cell(row = 1 , col = 1 ,comment = "This is the independent variable") %>% 
  hot_cell(row =1 ,col =2 ,comment = "This is the predictor variable" )


```

FREEZING COLOUMNS

```{r}
rhandsontable(mtcars) %>% 
  hot_cols(fixedColumnsLeft = 1)
```

RESIZING AND MOVING COLUMNS

```{r}
rhandsontable(regression_data) %>% 
  hot_cols(manualColumnMove = TRUE,manualColumnResize = TRUE)
```

```{r}
rhandsontable(multivariate_lec2_1) %>% 
  hot_cols(fixedColumnsLeft = 3 , manualColumnMove = TRUE ,manualColumnResize = TRUE)
```
